judgment.reasoning: An established roster requirement was violated

notApplicable.reason: the clause applies only to clients that support schema defaults by rendering forms; the SDK renders no forms (it only models `default` on the property schemas, acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/spec/AcpSchema.java:2817, 2889, 2949, 3005, 3064, and hands the request to the application's handler at AcpClient.java:836-848), so it is not such a client.

the applicability makes the SDK the subject only if it composes elicitation requests itself; it does not: `CreateElicitationRequest.form/url` take the application's message and schema (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/spec/AcpSchema.java:2462-2481) and `DefaultPromptContext` has no elicitation helper (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/agent/DefaultPromptContext.java).

same condition: the SDK composes no elicitation requests (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/spec/AcpSchema.java:2462-2481; no elicitation helper in DefaultPromptContext.java), so the mode choice is never the SDK's.

observations.message: before any initialize request has arrived the capability record is null and the request is sent unchecked (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/agent/DefaultAcpAsyncAgent.java:368-371, 379-380).

a core `initializeHandler` the application registers is answered verbatim, so a terminal method it lists is not filtered by the SDK (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/agent/AcpAgent.java:1282-1286).

a client with no elicitation handler answers `elicitation/create` with `-32601` rather than `-32602` (acp-core/src/main/java/com/agentclientprotocol/sdk/spec/AcpClientSession.java:319-327, 361-363), and before its initialize request every mode passes to the handler (AcpClient.java:864-866; ElicitationTest.java:247-262).
